Subject: Recap: HealthSpan discovery — stakeholder roster & procurement path

Hi Alex — great conversation today. Quick written recap and next steps so we all have the same view.

Call highlights
- Use case: automated clinical note summarization + downstream analytics for population health reporting.
- Pilot scope: subset of cardiology and primary-care clinics, ~3 months, up to 500k tokens/day peak.
- Success criteria: throughput at <150ms p50, accuracy on entity extraction > 92% on internal eval set, and stable cost <= $0.006/token.

Stakeholders (as discussed)
- Economic buyer: Alex Moreno (VP Product) — main commercial decision owner.
- Technical lead: Priya Sharma (Head of Eng) — wants a technical deep-dive and model performance metrics.
- Security / procurement: procurement@healthspan.ai (procurement lead) — will need SOC2 report, sub-processor list, and data retention policy.

Commercial asks / proposed exceptions
- Pilot discount: healthspan asked for a 10% pilot discount.
- SLA: they requested us to commit to 99.9% availability for inference endpoints for the pilot. Our standard pilot SLA is 99.5.

Internal asks (owners in parens)
- Ben: can you lead procurement run (questionnaire + evidence) and confirm what security gating we'd require to share model artifacts? (Ben)
- Dev: please confirm capacity/latency feasibility for the pilot topology and whether 99.5->99.9 is realistic without dedicated capacity. (Dev Patel)
- Laura: can you approve a pricing exception up to 10% for a 3-month pilot, pending revenue ops review? If not, please advise cap. (Laura)

Attachments: healthspan-discovery-notes.pdf, pilot-commercial-summary.xlsx

Next steps
1) Jasmine to schedule technical deep-dive with Priya (target: next Tue).
2) HealthSpan to share procurement questionnaire; Jasmine to route to Jen in Security if needed.
3) Internal review on pricing & SLA exceptions — Ben/Dev/Laura to reply by EOD Monday (11/23).

Thanks — I’ll keep the thread for the audit trail.

Best,
Jasmine Liu

Thanks for the clear recap, Jasmine. A few quick notes from procurement/security perspective:

- Evidence: we'll need their SOC 2 Type II report (last 12 months) and a completed security questionnaire. If they insist on the full sub-processor list, legal will want to review before we share our own sub-processors.
- Pen test / network access: Priya may ask for a limited pen-test window or a dataset sample. We should avoid any production data; a synthetic slice is fine.
- Pricing exception: I can escalate but recommend a cap at 7.5% discount for pilot unless the ARR forecast justifies 10%+; include a clause that makes the discount contingent on signing a 12-month renewal at list or a minimum committed spend.

Operational ask to Dev: please validate whether the requested latency target (p50 <150ms) at the stated load is achievable on our shared hosted tier. If not, outline cost delta for Dedicated vs Hosted.

I will start the security evidence request template and loop in Legal if they push on SLA language.

-Ben
Director, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
